changed_ranges.before:
If time is short

Keep the taught key idea, individual check, one review improvement and exit. Shorten extra matching turns or repeated playback. Do not let recording length hide understanding.
changed_ranges.after:
If behind

Must-teach core: explain one belief-to-choice link with relevant evidence, collect an individual hinge and six check responses including the extended comparison. Keep both exit questions.

Can be shortened: extra matching turns, repeated playback and decorative finishing. Use oral or exact scribed answers if recording is the barrier.

Next lesson: choose the opening example and route from the private RAG. Revisit belief, evidence and comparison vocabulary as needed.
